# Zaki Enterprises
> Global AI consultancy and automation solutions provider. Tagline: Intelligence That Moves Business Forward.

## Services
- [Excel Dashboard Development](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/excel-dashboard-development/): Professional Excel dashboard development: clean data, Pivot Tables, charts and KPI views that make business performance easy to see.
- [Excel Automation](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/excel-automation/): Excel automation services for recurring reports, data cleaning and repetitive spreadsheet work, built around your existing files.
- [Excel Data Analysis](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/excel-data-analysis/): Excel data analysis that cleans your data, finds trends and inefficiencies and explains the findings in plain language.
- [Google Sheets Automation](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/google-sheets-automation/): Google Sheets automation for reporting, data entry and syncing data between sheets and your other business tools.
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/ai-chatbot-development/): Custom AI chatbot development for websites, business communication and customer support, built on your own content.
- [Predictive Analytics & Forecasting](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/predictive-analytics-forecasting/): Predictive analytics and business forecasting: use historical data to estimate demand, sales and costs and plan with more confidence.
- [Computer Vision & Image Recognition](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/computer-vision-solutions/): Computer vision and image recognition solutions that detect, classify and count objects in images for inspection, sorting and monitoring.
- [NLP & Sentiment Analysis](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/nlp-sentiment-analysis/): Natural language processing and sentiment analysis: understand reviews, messages and survey responses at scale to find topics, mood and urgency.
- [AI CRM & Support Integration](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/ai-crm-support-integration/): AI CRM and customer support integration: connect AI to your CRM and help desk to classify requests, suggest replies and keep records updated.
- [Custom Machine Learning Development](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/custom-machine-learning/): Custom machine learning model development and deployment: models trained on your data for prediction, classification and decision support.
- [AI Strategy & Implementation Consulting](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/ai-strategy-consulting/): AI strategy consulting and implementation: identify the right AI opportunities, prioritize them and turn them into a practical plan.
- [Generative AI & LLM Solutions](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/generative-ai-solutions/): Generative AI and LLM solutions for business: assistants and tools that answer from your own documents, draft content and summarize information.
- [AI Receptionist](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/ai-receptionist/): AI receptionist for businesses: answer common enquiries, capture visitor details and handle appointment requests, with a clear handoff to your team.
- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/n8n-workflow-automation/): n8n workflow development and automation: connect apps, move data and automate repetitive business processes with reliable, tested workflows.
- [AI Business Automation](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/ai-business-automation/): Automate repetitive tasks, reporting and admin workflows with practical AI business automation designed around your processes.
- [API Integration & Automation](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/api-integration-automation/): API integration services that connect business apps, spreadsheets and AI tools into reliable automated workflows.
- [Document Processing Automation](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/document-processing-automation/): Automate document processing: extract information from invoices, forms and files, validate it and send it where it belongs.
- [AI Agent Development](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/ai-agent-development/): AI agent development for business: assistants that answer questions and perform suitable tasks within clear limits.
- [Social Media Automation](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/social-media-automation/): Social media automation for content planning, scheduling workflows and reporting, with human review before anything is published.
- [PowerPoint Presentation Design](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services/powerpoint-presentation-design/): Professional PowerPoint presentation design for business, pitches and reports, with clear structure and consistent branding.
